title: Row elimination update
statement: For natural numbers $p$ and $\mathrm{inv}$ and lists $\mathrm{piv}$ and $\mathrm{row}$, form a list by pairing the entries of the tails of $\mathrm{row}$ and $\mathrm{piv}$ up to the length of the shorter tail. For each paired entry $(r,y)$, the output is the remainder modulo $p$ of $r+p-(((\mathrm{head}(\mathrm{row})\cdot\mathrm{inv})\bmod p)\cdot y\bmod p)$; the head of an empty row is taken to be $0$.
